attributes.name: hero_imagery
attributes.definition: Whether the hero section includes a photograph or other visual media, or is text-only.

values.definition: Hero contains no photograph or image; only text and controls.
Hero includes a photograph or illustration.

attributes.name: hero_content_elements
attributes.definition: The set of content elements composing the hero block beyond the headline.

values.definition: Eyebrow label, large heading, subtitle and a single CTA.
Headline, short description, a stats row and a CTA.

attributes.name: hero_cta_shape
attributes.definition: Shape of the primary call-to-action button in the hero.

attributes.name: hero_layout_balance
attributes.definition: How hero content is positioned horizontally and whether space is left empty.

values.definition: Content arranged to sides with intentional empty space beside it.
Content stacked in a single centered column.
